Confirm whether budget authority alone captures the FY27 CHIMP / CHIMP Pop-Up mechanism correctly
observed_result: The CBO document's own multi-year spendout table shows the FY27 CHIMP Pop-Up (BA $0 in FY2027) carries a +$2,670,000,000 BA entry in FY2028 -- a single-year budget authority field doesn't represent this restoration. May need a dedicated CHIMP amount_type and/or a multi-year scorekeeping note field.
resolution: Deprioritized, not resolved. CHIMPs are a mandatory-spending mechanism by definition, and the Crime Victims Fund entry here is mandatory trust-fund plumbing, not a discretionary account. Given the platform is focused on discretionary accounts, a dedicated amount_type or multi-year scorekeeping field is not worth building for this. Left documented for historical accuracy; not blocking Step 3.
